definition:
【動詞】：〖俚語〗取得壓倒性嘅勝利 to achieve overwhelming victory, to walk all over someone

【詞綴】：〖外來語〗用法同「之」。日文本身讀no[nɔ̜̝]，係「…之…、…嘅…」噉解。但受到香港品牌「優の良品」讀做「優之良品」影響，中文夾雜「の」字嘅話，多數會讀成「之」，或者直接用返「之」字代替，例如商場「新の城」會讀做「新之城」甚至打成「新之城」。喺現今香港，有唔少舖頭、品牌為求睇落去有日本嘅風味，都會用個「の」字去代替「的／之／嘅」字 used the same way as 之; loan from Japanese; it is pronounced "no" [nɔ̜ ̝] in Japanese, but in Hong Kong it is often simply pronounced "之 (zi1)", and the character "之" can be substituted in place of "の"; for example "新の城" is pronounced "新之城" and can be written as "新之城"; in Hong Kong, many brand names use "の" in place of "之" in attempt to pass off as authentic Japanese

【語句】：〖俚語〗形容一樣物件嘅體積好細小。豆潤即係豆腐乾。因新鮮豆腐好快變壞,啲板豆腐賣唔晒會攞去加工，壓水，有時會加鹵水煮，再焙乾或晒乾後成為一片片細塊，可以存放好耐。因豆腐壓去水份再煮會縮細好多，所以用來形容體積細小之物。 to describe the smallness of something. Literally: as small as a dried bean curd. This comes from the fact that fresh bean curds rot very quickly, so for preservation purposes the unsold tofu are pressed under weight to remove water, sometimes boiled in tempered soy sauce, and finally dried by oven or sunlight. As dried bean curds shrink considerably, it has come to describe something that is tiny. Literally: as small as a dried bean curd cube

↳ 而家經濟咁差，冇升職加薪呢支歌仔唱㗎喇。
　 Nowadays the economic situation is so poor. Benefits like promotion or getting a rise are no longer viable.

pronunciation: mou5 ni1 zi1 go1 zai2 coeng3
definition:
【語句】：比喻過去可行嘅方法而家行唔通 used to describe that a method used in the past no longer works due to change of circumstances
↳ 唔好再信勤力讀書就考到5**，冇呢支歌仔唱㗎喇。
　 Stop believing that paying efforts will lead to getting Level 5**. This strategy will not work anymore.

【區別詞】：冇攞牌（牌照、許可）嘅 unlicensed
↳ 無牌小販
　 unlicensed hawker
↳ 無牌駕駛
　 driving without a license

【形容詞】：唔按章法或者規矩，冇組織條埋 disordered; disorganised; unexpected
↳ 啲後生仔做嘢都冇譜嘅！
　 Young people work in such a disorderly manner!

【形容詞】：頂唔順 unbearable
↳ 呢幾日啲天氣熱到冇譜。
　 During these few days the weather has been unbearably hot.

〖非標準〗「冇譜」嘅俗字
nonstandard variant of 冇譜 mou5 pou2

【形容詞】：〖非標準〗唔按章法或者規矩，冇組織條埋 disordered; disorganised; unexpected
↳ 啲後生仔做嘢都無譜嘅！
　 Young people work in such a disorderly manner!

【形容詞】：〖非標準〗頂唔順 unbearable
↳ 呢幾日啲天氣熱到無譜。
　 During these few days the weather has been unbearably hot.

【動詞】：做咗一件事而事前冇意圖 to not mean to; to be unintentional
↳ 佢其實冇心傷害你㗎，唔好嬲佢啦。
　 He actually didn't mean to hurt you, please don't be angry at him.

【名詞】：唔小心而造成嘅失誤，唔係特登做錯嘅（量詞：個／次） unintentional or careless mistake
↳ 你就原諒佢今次嘅無心之失啦，我諗佢唔會再有下次㗎喇。
　 Please forgive him for his unintentional mistake this time. I think he will not do it in the future.

【形容詞】：冇私心嘅；唔顧自己全心為其他人嘅 selfless
↳ 無私嘅愛
　 selfless love
↳ 無私奉獻
　 selfless devotion
其他讀音：mou4 si4 mou4 haak1

【副詞】：每個時刻；任何一刻 every moment; constantly; all the time
↳ 我無時無刻都會掛住你。
　 I will miss you every moment.

【動詞】：當一個人或一樣嘢唔存在 to treat someone or something as if it did not exist; to ignore; to neglect; to disregard
↳ 唔好無視我嘅存在呀！
　 Don't treat me as if I don't exist!

【動詞】：安全，冇大礙 all right; no matter; safe
↳ 我冇事，你唔駛擔心。
　 There is nothing wrong with me. You don't need to worry.
↳ 見到你冇事，我就放心嘞。
　 After seeing that you're alright, then I'm relieved.

【動詞】：冇特別原因 to have nothing special
↳ 「你揾我做咩啊？」 「冇事，揾你傾下偈啫。」
　 "Why are you looking for me?" "Nothing special, I just want to chat."

【形容詞】：好安靜，唔引起人注意嘅情況下 without any sound; silently
↳ 個賊仔無聲無息噉潛入咗我間屋。
　 The thief broke into my house silently.
↳ 佢無聲無息噉就消失咗。
　 He disappeared without a trace.

【動詞】：冇嘢可以做；唔做嘢 to have nothing to do; to do nothing
↳ 我唔明點解佢畢業之後唔揾工，成日都無所事事。
　 I don't understand why he doesn't look for a job but does nothing all day.
↳ 暑假無所事事，好悶呀！
　 I have nothing to do during the summer holiday. I am bored!

【語句】：（喺某啲情況或者制度之下）唔知可以點做 (under certain situations or mechanisms) to not know what to do or say; to be without a set of rules to follow; to be at a loss
↳ 教育制度不斷改變，老師、家長同學生都無所適從。
　 The ever-changing education system has left teachers, parents and students at a loss as for what to do.

【動詞】：唔在意；唔介意 never mind; not to mind; to be indifferent; to be neutral over sth

　 I don't mind where we go to eat as long as the restaurant is fast at serving up the food.

　 The world is ever-changing, no one knows what will happen next.

【語句】：冇其他原因、因素 without any other reason or factor
↳ 無他嘅，佢唔 likey 你吖嘛，咪喺度搞咁多小動作囉。
　 He dislikes you without a reason, so just don't make petty tricks behind his back.
↳ 我相信好多人一聽到中國葡萄酒都會驚驚，無他嘅，國內太多假食物假酒。
　 I believe that many people are 'frightened' by the Chinese wine without a specific reason since China is infamous for fake food and wine.

【語句】：無嘢好講；無言 having nothing to say; speechless
↳ 件事唔關我事，你係要怪我噉我都無話可説。
　 This matter has nothing to do with me but you keep blaming me. Then I have nothing to say.

【語句】：無嘢好講；無言 having nothing to say; speechless

【形容詞】：唔重要、無聊、濕星 unimportant; inconsequential; trivial
↳ 唔好成日做埋晒啲無謂嘢，正正經經揾啲嘢學下啦！
　 Don't waste your time on trivial things. Go find something meaningful to learn!
↳ 我老婆行街，成日買埋啲無謂嘢。
　 My wife always buys useless stuff when she goes shopping.

【形容詞】：冇用、嘥氣、冇意義 useless; meaningless
↳ 喊都無謂
　 it's no use crying over spilt milk
↳ 你唔睇實你個銀包，一陣俾人撻咗，就真係喊都無謂。
　 Look after your purse, or you'll regret when it gets stolen.

【形容詞】：自己本身無乜知識，人講乜佢就信，好易俾人呃 ignorant; naive; unsophisticated
↳ 無知少女
　 naive young girls

【形容詞】：唔會有完結、停止嘅一刻 without an end; bottomless; endless; limitless; unlimited
↳ 無止境嘅等待

↳ 佢咁爛賭，你借錢俾佢無止境㗎！
　 He's addicted to gambling. It will be endless if you lend him money!

【形容詞】：覺得冇人幫到自己 helpless
↳ 佢揾工揾咗半年，覺得好無助。
　 He's been searching for a job for half a year, he feels so helpless.

【語句】：虛構、老作謠言；造謠 to fabricate; to create a rumour; literally: from nothing to create something
↳ 根本就冇噉嘅事，你唔好聽佢無中生有喇。
　 There isn't such a thing at all. You shouldn't believe the rumours he creates.

【動詞】：捏造事實，作出不實嘅指控 to falsely accuse; to frame; to trump up a charge against

↳ 模型車

↳ 做模特兒，一般要有高瘦嘅身材。

↳ 我六歲之前嘅記憶好模糊。

【形容詞】：非常之好，冇得再好；好到冇咩野可以超越到 superb; great; unbeatable; excellent; extremely good; second to none

There is always a way out.; literally: heaven never seals off its exits

【形容詞】：太陽未出，個天僅僅現藍嘅時候，黎明剛剛開始嘅時分，比天光早少少 early at dawn
↳ 佢住好遠，天矇光就要起身返工。
　 He lives far away so he has to wake up at the crack of dawn to go to work.

【名詞】：世界最偏遠嘅角落 The ends of the earth; the remotest corner of the earth
↳ 就算你去到天涯，我都會跟住你。
　 Even if you go to the ends of the earth, I will follow you.

【名詞】：一種雀鳥，熟水性，通常係全身白色或者黑色（量詞：隻） swan
↳ 《天鵝湖》
　 "Swan Lake"
↳ 癩蝦蟆想食天鵝肉
　 a plain guy who dreams of dating someone out of his league; literally: a skin-diseased toad wants to eat swan meat

【名詞】：紗線均勻分布、絨毛短而密、質感柔軟嘅絲織品（量詞：塊）
velvet

【語句】：惡行引起普遍嘅怨憤同不滿
widespread indignation and discontent over one's evil doings; literally: wrath of God and anger of men

【名詞】：即係天台（量詞：個）
rooftop

【名詞】：衡量物體輕重嘅工具（量詞:個）
a balance; (a pair of) scales

【名詞】：見天秤座
(astronomy)Libra

【名詞】：見天秤座
(astronomy)Libra

【名詞】：〖香港〗又叫塔式起重機，係一種搬運工具，通常會喺大嘅地盤見到，用作搬運建築材料、建築機械等
tower crane

【語句】：形容伴侶好合襯 (of suitability of couples) well-matched
↳ 佢哋天生一對，又好愛對方。
　 They are such a couple match-made in heaven and they love each other.
其他讀音：tin1 si5

【名詞】：上天或者神嘅使者（量詞：個／位／名） angel
↳ 好多人心目中嘅天使，都係背脊有翼，頭上有光環嘅。
　 People usually imagine angels as having wings and a halo.

【名詞】：氣候 (also 天口 /tin1hau2/)(compare 天氣 /tin1hei3/) weather
↳ 大熱天時
　 hot weather
↳ 天時熱要飲多啲水。
　 One should drink more water when the weather is hot.

【名詞】：自然有利嘅時機 opportunity
↳ 天時地利人和
　 good timing, geographical convenience and good human relations.

【名詞】：時間 timeliness
↳ 天時尚早

【名詞】：天空嘅顏色，指當時嘅天氣或者時間 colour of the sky; time of the day as shown by the colour of the sky; weather
↳ 雖然天色已晚，但係街上面仲有好多人。
　 Although it's already nighttime, there are lots of people on the streets.
↳ 天色開始變暗，我哋都係快啲揾個地方避雨。
　 The sky is getting gloomy. We'd better find somewhere to hide from the rain.

【名詞】：用作發射或者接收無線電波嘅裝置；視乎用途，有唔同嘅設計同大細，常見嘅有長條形、魚骨形同碟形等設計（量詞：條） aerial; antenna
↳ 電視天線
　 television antenna

【名詞】：天生嘅本性 human disposition; natural instinct; inborn nature; human nature
↳ 懶惰係人嘅天性。
　 Laziness is a human disposition.

【名詞】：好有用、實用嘅書（量詞：本） book of great use; beneficial book
↳ 考試天書
　 book which provides useful tips for the examination

【名詞】：一棟建築物嘅露天頂層平台（量詞：個） rooftop (platform)
↳ 天台攝影
　 rooftopping
↳ 天台酒吧
　 rooftop bar

【名詞】：一啲傳統信仰裏面人死後靈魂去享樂嘅地方（量詞：個）
heaven; paradise after death

【名詞】：比喻一個條件最優秀嘅地方（量詞：個） figuratively, a paradise; the most outstanding place for something
↳ 香港係購物天堂。
　 Hong Kong is a paradise for shopping.
↳ 秋葉原係宅男天堂。
　 Akihabara is a nerd heaven.

【名詞】：喺某個行業做得好出色嘅人(量詞:名/位/個) person who is accomplished and famous in a particular industry; literally: "king of"
↳ 飲食天王
　 king of the catering industry
↳ 補習天王
　 star tutor

【名詞】：特登指九十年代香港娛樂圈嘅四大天王
the four leading male stars of Hong Kong Cantonese pop music in the 1990s; see 四大天王

【名詞】：日本君主、元首嘅稱號
the Emperor of Japan

【名詞】：太陽系嘅第七個行星
Uranus, the seventh planet of the solar system

【形容詞】：純真、幼稚，諗嘢好單純 naive; innocent
↳ 天真無邪
　 innocent; childlike
↳ 我當時真係好傻好天真。
　 I was so silly and naive by that time.

【形容詞】：純真、幼稚，諗嘢好單純 naive; innocent
↳ 天真無邪
　 innocent; childlike
↳ 我當時真係好傻好天真。
　 I was so silly and naive by that time.

【名詞】：建築物內部露天嘅位置（量詞：個）
courtyard; atrium; literally "sky well"

【名詞】：天生、先天嘅資質 natural gift; talent
↳ 天資聰敏
　 talented and intelligent

【名詞】：古代中國天下共主；被視為上天嘅代表，天命所歸，得以統治人民（量詞：名／位／個）
Chinese emperor; divine ruler of the world; literally: son of Heaven

【名詞】：天然繼承落到自己身上嘅責任；有時亦都係自我嘅主觀投射 inherent responsibility
↳ 教養下一代係父母嘅天職。
　 To bring up the next generation is the inherent responsibility of parents.

【名詞】：自然現象所造成嘅災難（量詞：次／場） natural disaster
↳ 三分天災，七分人禍
　 30% of natural disaster and 70% of man-made calamity

【名詞】：天主教徒對佢哋所信仰、主宰一切嘅神嘅稱呼（量詞：個） (of Catholic) Lord; God
↳ 人死咗之後就會返去天主嘅懷抱安息。
　 After one's death, he will rest in the Lord's embrace.

【專名】：即係羅馬天主教，係基督教嘅一個主要教派，亦都係人數最多嘅教會 (Roman) Catholicism, (Roman) Catholic Church
↳ 天主教香港教區
　 Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong

【專名】：即係羅馬天主教，係基督教嘅一個主要教派，亦都係人數最多嘅教會 (Roman) Catholicism, (Roman) Catholic Church
↳ 天主教香港教區
　 Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong

【名詞】：用作耕種嘅土地或範圍（量詞：塊／畝） farm; agricultural land; field
↳ 農田
　 agricultural field
↳ 稻田
　 rice paddy

【專名】：姓
a surname, usually transliterated as "Tin"

【名詞】：耕種用嘅土地 field; farm
↳ 我阿爺喺鄉下有好多田地。
　 My grandfather has a lot of fields in his home village.

【名詞】：困難、唔樂觀嘅處境 wretched situation; plight
↳ 點解我哋會搞到噉嘅田地㗎？
　 How did we end up like this?

【名詞】：虎紋蛙，食得。廣東人喺田度捉嚟食，因而得名。一般南方人亦叫青蛙做田雞 an edible frog, Hoplobatrachus tigerinus; literally: field chicken
↳ 照田雞

【名詞】：虎紋蛙，食得。廣東人喺田度捉嚟食，因而得名。一般南方人亦叫青蛙做田雞 an edible frog, Hoplobatrachus tigerinus; literally: field chicken
↳ 照田雞

【名詞】：陸上運動嘅一個種類，可以再細分為「田賽」（例如跳高、跳遠、擲鐵餅等）同埋「徑賽」（例如跑步、跨欄）項目 athletics; track and field
↳ 玩田徑
　 to be a track and field athlete
↳ 學界田徑比賽
　 inter-school athletic competition

【名詞】：田地；原野；郊外 countryside; open country; field
↳ 廣闊嘅田野
　 a vast open country
↳ 退休之後我想過啲田野生活。
　 I want to spend some time in the field after I retire.

【名詞】：為咗學習或者工作而出發去研究、考察嘅實地 a place where one is working or studying in real situations, away from the school or office
↳ 田野考察
　 field study; fieldwork
↳ 人類學家經常喺田野入面觀察同參與；呢樣係佢哋基本嘅研究方法。
　 Observation and participation in the field, which anthropologists often do, is their basic research methodology.

【名詞】：田地園圃(量詞：個) fields; countryside
↳ 歸隱田園
　 to go to the countryside and live in seclusion

【動詞】：加嘢入凹陷嘅地方；喺空白嘅地方加入內容 to fill; to fill up; to fill in; to fill out; to stuff
↳ 填表
　 to fill out a form
↳ 嗰個窿填平咗喇！
　 The hole has been filled up and levelled out.

【動詞】：加嘢入凹陷嘅地方；喺空白嘅地方加入內容 to fill; to fill up; to fill in; to fill out; to stuff
↳ 填表
　 to fill out a form
↳ 嗰個窿填平咗喇！
　 The hole has been filled up and levelled out.

【動詞】：食到飽為止 to eat until one is full
↳ 填飽個肚
　 to eat sth to fill one's stomach

【動詞】：食到飽為止 to eat until one is full

↳ 填補空缺
　 to fill a vacancy

　 to apply for a university

【動詞】：填寫表格嚟報名或者申請一啲嘢 to fill in a form for application

　 to apply for a university

↳ 填報已更改嘅資料
　 to report changed information

【動詞】：填寫同遞交表格，以作行政、管理用途 to report information in a form and submit for administrative/mangament purposes
↳ 填報已更改嘅資料
　 to report changed information

【動詞】：為旋律按節拍配上通常押韻嘅字句做歌詞（使用某啲聲調語言嘅話，仲要注意字句聲調要配合埋旋律走向，即係啱音） to write lyrics for a song
↳ 填詞人
　 lyricist; songwriter

【動詞】：為旋律按節拍配上通常押韻嘅字句做歌詞（使用某啲聲調語言嘅話，仲要注意字句聲調要配合埋旋律走向，即係啱音） to write lyrics for a song
↳ 填詞人
　 lyricist; songwriter

【動詞】：按詞牌去創作傳統嘅詞（獨有體裁）
to create a classical Chinese verse ("ci")

【動詞】：按詞牌去創作傳統嘅詞（獨有體裁）
to create a classical Chinese verse ("ci")

【名詞】：一種考試測驗嘅題目形式；會有一啲唔完整嘅句子，上面有啲空格，學生就要填返啲適當嘅詞語落去，通常都有標準答案 fill-in-the-blank format (in a test or examination)
↳ 填充題
　 fill-in-the-blank question

【名詞】：一種考試測驗嘅題目形式；會有一啲唔完整嘅句子，上面有啲空格，學生就要填返啲適當嘅詞語落去，通常都有標準答案 fill-in-the-blank format (in a test or examination)
↳ 填充題
　 fill-in-the-blank question

【動詞】：進行工程，用沙泥等填料傾倒落海牀，將空間填到高過海面，以增加土地 to reclaim land (from the sea); land reclamation
↳ 呢度填緊海，第時可能會起樓。
　 They are reclaiming land in this area, and will probably build some buildings in the future.

【動詞】：進行工程，用沙泥等填料傾倒落海牀，將空間填到高過海面，以增加土地 to reclaim land (from the sea); land reclamation
↳ 呢度填緊海，第時可能會起樓。
　 They are reclaiming land in this area, and will probably build some buildings in the future.

【動詞】：將本身凹落去嘅海、湖、河或者土地變成同周邊嘅地方差唔多高嘅平地
to fill in order to elevate something to the same level as its surrounding place

【動詞】：將本身凹落去嘅海、湖、河或者土地變成同周邊嘅地方差唔多高嘅平地
to fill in order to elevate something to the same level as its surrounding place

【動詞】：將需要嘅資料寫喺所指定嘅空間 to fill in; to write
↳ 填寫表格
　 to fill in the form

【動詞】：將需要嘅資料寫喺所指定嘅空間 to fill in; to write
↳ 填寫表格
　 to fill in the form

【名詞】：一種文字遊戲，有好多打橫打直排嘅空格，透過提示嚟估應該填啲咩字入格仔（量詞：個） crossword puzzle
↳ 我老豆每日睇報紙都鍾意玩填字遊戲。
　 My dad loves solving the crossword puzzle when he reads the newspaper every day.

【名詞】：一種文字遊戲，有好多打橫打直排嘅空格，透過提示嚟估應該填啲咩字入格仔（量詞：個） crossword puzzle
↳ 我老豆每日睇報紙都鍾意玩填字遊戲。
　 My dad loves solving the crossword puzzle when he reads the newspaper every day.

【名詞】：今日之後嗰一日（量詞：個） tomorrow
↳ 你聽日會唔會出街？
　 Will you go out tomorrow?
↳ 聽日先算咯。
　 I'll leave it for tomorrow.

【名詞】：聽日嘅朝頭早 tomorrow morning
↳ 我唔理，總之我聽朝返到公司要見到你份報告。
　 I don't give a damn about anything else but your report on my desk tomorrow morning.

【動詞】：中止某個行為 to stop; to cease; to halt; to pause
↳ 停課
　 class suspension
↳ 請停筆！
　 Please stop writing!

【動詞】：將架車放喺某個地方 (of cars) to be parked; (of ships) to lie at anchor
↳ 架車停喺大門得喇！
　 Just park your car at the entrance.

【名詞】：用嚟俾一堆車輛暫時停泊嘅空間或者建築物（量詞：個／座） car park
↳ 臨時停車場
　 temporary car park
↳ 你都係將架車泊返入停車場啦，唔係俾人抄牌就得不償失㗎喇。
　 It's better for you to park the car in the car park. The loss will outweigh the gain if you get a ticket.

【名詞】：活動、動作暫時停止嘅動作（量詞：個） halt; pause; stand still
↳ 對話之間嘅停頓
　 pauses between a conversation

【動詞】：中止或者暫停 to stop; to pause; to suspend; to stand still
↳ 喺疫情下，世界好似停頓咗。
　 During the pandemic, the world seemed to stand still.
↳ 我停頓咗一陣先答。
　 I paused for a while and then answered.

【動詞】：供電系統停止運作 to have a power cut; to have a blackout
↳ 頂，交成萬蚊管理費都成日停電。
　 Why on earth is the property management fee so expensive when there are constant power outages?

【動詞】：暫停戰爭；停止戰爭中嘅武力衝突，嘗試談判 to cease fire
↳ 停火協議
　 ceasefire agreement

【動詞】：學校因為惡劣天氣或事故等原因，喺原本要返學嘅日子放假，等學生唔使返學 (for schools) to suspend classes; to be suspended
↳ 今日紅雨，所以中小學停晒課。
　 Due to the red rainstorm signal (issued) today, the secondary and primary schools are all suspended.

【名詞】：專門俾飛機、直升機升降同上落客貨嘅廣闊平地（量詞：塊／片）
aircraft parking apron; aircraft parking area

【動詞】：一個人停止返學；通常係俾校方要求嘅
to stop going to school; to suspend studies
其他讀音：ting4 hon1

【動詞】：報紙或者雜誌等定期出版嘅刊物停止發行 to stop publication of a periodic publication like newspapers or magazines
↳ 佢同朋友夾份開報社，唔夠半年停刊。
　 He started a newspaper with his friend and printing stopped after half a year.

【動詞】：商業機構唔做生意，關門大吉 to stop doing business; to close down
↳ 內部維修，暫時停業。
　 Temporarily closed for repairs.

【動詞】：暫時留喺一個地方，唔走住 to stay for a time; to stop; to remain
↳ 我喺香港停留咗一個禮拜。
　 I stayed in Hong Kong for a week.
其他讀音：ting4 paai4

【語句】：暫停牌照 to disqualify a licence
↳ 佢成日衝紅燈， 最後俾人停牌。
　 He always jumps a red light and finally his driving licence was disqualified.
↳ 個練馬師因佢隻馬嘅尿液樣本驗出含違禁物，而俾董事小組判罰停牌八個賽事日。
　 That trainer has lodged an appeal against the severity of the penalty imposed on him by the stipendiary stewards following urine sample taken from the horse which was found to contain a prohibited substance.

【語句】：一隻股票喺交易所臨時禁止交易 (of stocks) to be suspended
↳ 由於中國銀行預告要公布業績，星期二上海證券所對佢實施停牌。
　 Trading in the Bank of China was suspended on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Tuesday pending a profit announcement.

【語句】：（賭博）停止發牌 to stop drawing (in card game)
↳ 如果莊家嘅點數等於或大過17點，則必須要停牌。
　 (Blackjack) The dealer's hand is resolved by drawing cards until the hand achieves a value of 17 or higher.

【動詞】：船隻停靠響一個港口 (of ships) to anchor; to berth
↳ 個海港好大，可以停泊大型郵輪。
　 The harbour is big enough for cruise ships to anchor.

【動詞】：車輛停靠響一個地方 (of cars) to park
↳ 嚴禁停泊車輛
　 Car-parking is prohibited

【動詞】：停止呢一刻做緊嘅事 to stop one's movement; to stop one's action
↳ 你好快啲停手喇！
　 You'd better stop at once.

【語句】：停喺某一個階段、境況而毫無進展
stagnant; at a standstill; not moving forward, to make no progress

【動詞】：以後或者暫時唔再做一件事 to stop; to cease; to halt; to suspend

　 Fire! Cut the ropes quickly or the fire will spread to the other ships!

【動詞】：終結關係；一刀兩斷；分手並且劃清界線 to sever ties; to sever relationships, especially romantic relationships
↳ 佢父母唔鍾意嗰個女仔，逼佢哋斬纜。
　 His parents dislike his girlfriend and are forcing him to break up with her.

【動詞】：終止一啲已經開始咗嘅項目 to stop an on-going project, event, etc.
↳ 個節目拍咗十幾集無端端斬纜，一定有內情。
　 This television show was suddenly discontinued after being broadcast for more than ten episodes. Something is not right.

【動詞】：終止投資，避免承受更多損失 to sell off an investment and to cut losses

【名詞】：對自己屋企嘅謙稱 a humble term to refer to one's own home

【動詞】：形容響石屎地球場踢波時跌倒，皮膚畀地面刮親。早年公園石地球場由小石粒鋪面，用嚟防滑，但表面粗糙如磨牀，若果跌倒時皮膚擦落地面會嚴重磨損，就如攞薑響磨牀度磨咁，血肉模糊。 to describe the skin scratched on the ground when playing football on concrete field. In early year, public football in the parks are laid with gravel to avoid slippery, but if one fall on the ground, the skin will be seriously hurt like scratching a ginger on the grinder.
↳ 尋日踢波個膝頭又磨薑喇，痛到喊。
　 Yesterday I got my knee badly scratched on the ground again, it hurts so bad that makes me cry.

【名詞】：〖外來語〗〖術語〗足球或網球術語：足球時指接應隊友高空傳球時，球不著地立即射門或再傳波；網球就指未等來球著地就回擊。音譯自英文volley（排球或拋物），打排球時候波不能落地，以此比喻球不著地。 to take a volley pass by direct shooting or passing away when the ball is still in the middle of air.
↳ 4號大腳向前傳中，3號仔門前接應，窩梨抽射，入左！！
　 No.4 takes a long pass to the central front, No.3 gets the spot in front of the goal, volley shoot, GOALLLLL !!

　 This young man not only can dribbling with nice twists but also can shoot well, we all praise him for that.

↳ 呢個8號仔正一濕手巾，顧住自己扭波，死都唔肯交
　 This no.8 is a wet handkerchief, keep twisting on his own and refuse to pass.

definition:

【副詞】：表示對上一句嘅否定，並提出糾正；通常放喺糾正咗嘅謂語後面，間唔中會配合反問句使用 negates the previous sentence so as to correct an error; usually placed after the predicate (phrase) of the correction and sometimes used in conjunction with a rhetorical question

　 You think this is an apple? It's actually an orange.
↳ 點會嫌你多事呢？多謝你就真！

↳ 呢個球員可以好黐腳噉帶波，好厲害。
　 This player can keep the ball very closely to his feet while dribbling, brilliant.

【動詞】：〖術語〗足球術語；將球由場邊或後場踢到前場中心區域 soccer jargon; centering the ball or crossing to the center - a medium to long range pass from a side or rear part of the field towards the center of the field near the opponent's goal
↳ 呢下傳中落點啱啱好，前鋒控定一射就入左 !
　 This centering has hit the sweet spot, the forward just need to hold, shoot and goal !

【動詞】：〖術語〗足球術語；由底線兩邊向龍門口前方踢出嘅傳中波 soccer jargon; centering from the flank near the endline towards the field in front of the opponent's goal
↳ 呢下底線傳中就靚喇，帶住少少西彎出黎，唔止後衞，連龍門都呃埋。
　 This centering from the endline is so beautiful, with a little side spin and curve, not only the full backs, even the goalkeeper also got cheated.

【動詞】：〖術語〗足球術語；嘲笑用語；失敗左嘅底線傳中-由底線兩邊向龍門口踢出傳中波，但去唔到龍門前方，直接出左底線 soccer jargon; ridicule term; "to center the ball from endline toward endline" - a failed centering pass from the flank near endline, the ball doesn't reach the field in front of opponent's goal, but flies directly outside endline.
↳ 佢落底線係幾快嘅，不過慘在成日底線傳底呢...
　 He can rush quite fast toward the endline, but tragically often center the ball from endline toward the endline...

【名詞】：網上俾人傾計嘅共同空間，容許用户以文字、聲音或影像同多人即時通訊嘅程式（量詞：個） chatroom
↳ 我同我老公係喺聊天室度識嘅。

↳ 今次總統大選我兩個都投唔落手，唯有投白票以示不滿。
　 I don't want to vote for either of the two presidential candidates, so all I can do is cast a blank vote to declare my dissatisfaction.

【動詞】：〖潮語〗〖術語〗選舉術語；為咗分薄某候選人嘅票源，而派出一個理念相近嘅另一候選人參選 (election jargon) to "bleed" away votes, to snatch votes, by running in an election in a constituency that already has another candidate who shares a similar profile / political view
↳ 大家理念都唔同，根本就唔係鎅票。
　 Our views are different. We are not snatching your votes.

【動詞】：〖潮語〗〖術語〗選舉術語；為咗分薄某候選人嘅票源，而派出一個理念相近嘅另一候選人參選 (election jargon) to "bleed" away votes, to snatch votes, by running in an election in a constituency that already has another candidate who shares a similar profile / political view

Usually used when the contribution distribution is disproportional; while "chicken" (gai1) means the larger part, the soy sauce (si6 jau4) means the smaller part, one side provides more than the other. Literally means "you provide the chicken, I provide the soy sauce." Order can be reversed "...provide the soy sauce, ...provide the chicken." The side who provides the soy sauce is normally perceived as getting the better of the exchange, while the side providing the chicken is seen as getting the shorter end of the stick.
↳ 人哋出雞，你淨係出豉油咋，呢單交易抵到爛啦！
　 They provide the chicken, and you only need to provide the soy sauce. This deal is a steal!
↳ 人哋出豉油咋，你同佢出雞？你好蝕囉！
　 They provide the soy sauce, and you provide them with the chicken? You'll lose big time!

Then each one shows his/her hand in front of his/her chest and flip it twice immediately after that. While showing his/her hand, each one says 孖 (jyutping: maa1), and while flipping his/hand hand, each one says 術師 (jyutping:seot6 si1), one character for one flip. If the division is not even or more teams are to be divided, the above procedures could be taken multiple times.

Jehovah's Witnesses

【名詞】：耶和華見證人嘅簡稱 abbreviation for Jehovah's Witnesses; JW
↳ 呢排樓下好多耶證派單張。
　 These days there are a lot of Jehovah's Witnesses downstairs handing out leaflets.

【名詞】：外皮黃色嘅火龍果（量詞：隻／個）
yellow dragon fruit; yellow pitaya; yellow pitahaya
其他讀音：baak3 gaa1 lei6

【名詞】：〖外來語〗北美華人（尤其温哥華）對於西蘭花嘅另一個稱呼
Phonetic translation of broccoli, used among ethnic Chinese in North America (especially in Vancouver) alongside with 西蘭花

【名詞】：〖俚語〗〖黃賭毒〗一種放蕩或唔檢點外觀或感覺令人覺得嗰個人會參與賣淫 a dissolute or unconventional look and feel that imply someone would work as a prostitute
↳ 睇佢一啲撈味都無，估唔到佢會跑私鐘。
　 She doesn't seem promiscuous at all; I'm surprised she engaged in prostitution.
↳ 嘩，你今日套衫好唔掂喎，著到個人成陣撈味咁嘅。
　 Your outfit today looks inappropriate and cheap.
其他讀音：je4 ceng1

【名詞】：〖俚語〗指信奉耶教、即係基督教，而一般熱衷於教會活動同傳教嘅嘅青年；因為同椰青食字而得名 Christian youth, especially those passionate in their faith
↳ 耶青團體
　 Christian youth groups

【名詞】：紅薯粉；番薯整成嘅粉麪，透明粗身有咬口
sweet potato noodles

【名詞】：木薯粉；木薯磨成粉狀加工嘅食品
tapioca

【動詞】：隱藏秘密，唔畀人知。通常啲秘密係心事。 to hide secrets so that others would not know (Usually the secrets are feelings, worries, or loads on one's mind.)
↳ 佢望落好唔開心，但係問佢佢又收收埋埋，唔肯同人講佢發生咗咩事。
　 He looks very sad, but when people ask him, he hides his feelings, not willing to tell them about what has happened to him.
↳ 佢成日做嘢收收埋埋，都唔知係唔係有咩唔見得光。
　 He always works like he is hiding something; who knows if there is something illegal.

【量詞】：十二打，即係144個
gross, a group of 144 items
其他讀音：syu4 zai2 man2

【名詞】：〖術語〗特指喺工作場合接獲投訴或者發生事故之後需要撰寫嘅報告，尤其是長篇、麻煩，或者冇必要嘅時候 incident report, or internal report in response to a complaint, especially when lengthy, troublesome or unnecessary (originally from English "statement")
↳ 我哋個department又畀人port喇，又要寫薯仔文畀老細。
　 Our department received yet another complaint, and we have to write a lengthy report to the boss again.

【名詞】：〖術語〗泛指工作上要寫嘅長篇報告
in general refers to long work reports to be composed

【語句】：冇收入 to have no income
↳ X

〖非標準〗「冇飯開」嘅俗字
nonstandard variant of 冇飯開 mou5 faan6 hoi1

【語句】：〖非標準〗冇收入 to have no income
↳ X

【名詞】：〖潮語〗大學生術語，指唔多社交嘅人 university slang referring to reclusive and unsociable people.
↳ 班摺友日日獨來獨往，無同佢地傾過解。
　 Those unsociable people always kept to themselves. Never talked to them.

【名詞】：豬、牛等嘅主動脈弓作為食材嘅叫法
aortic arch of animals (as food)

【名詞】：黃白間條魚肉膠入面包住飛魚子嘅丸（量詞：粒）
fish ball with yellow and white stripes, stuffed with tobiko (flying fish roe); literally: sea urchin ball

【名詞】：蒟蒻絲，注意唔係芋頭
shirataki, konjac yam shreds

【名詞】：鵪鶉嘅蛋
quail egg

【名詞】：將麪筋炸成一個空心嘅大波，用嚟打邊爐
gluten ball, a common ingredient for hot pot

【名詞】：將麪筋炸成一個空心嘅大波，用嚟打邊爐
gluten ball, a common ingredient for hot pot

【名詞】：即係麩質
gluten

【名詞】：預先去殼用膠兜裝住嘅嘅蠔，唔可以生食
bottled oysters; jarred oysters; oysters packaged in a relatively large "bucket" and not intended to be eaten raw

【名詞】：一種綠色長形蔬菜，表面有明顯紋理，煮熟後帶有黏液，常見於煲湯或炒菜（量詞：條）
okra; "ladies' fingers"

【名詞】：〖外來語〗一種新陳代謝產生嘅化合物，衍生物包括係核酸重要嘅組成部份嘅鹼基：胞嘧啶(C)、胸腺嘧啶(T)同尿嘧啶(U)（另見嘌呤）
pyrimidine

【名詞】：即係強直性脊椎炎，係一種自身免疫失調而主要影響脊椎嘅慢性關節炎，亦都有機會影響眼（虹膜炎）、皮膚（牛皮癬）同腸道（炎症性腸病）
(med.) ankylosing spondylitis

【名詞】：即係脊骨神經醫學，係一種替代醫學；理論基於透過矯正肌肉同骨骼系統嚟治療唔同嘅病 chiropractic
↳ 佢見香港冇得讀脊醫，所以過咗美國讀。
　 He realised that he can't study chiropractic in Hong Kong, so he went to the US for it.

【名詞】：從事脊骨神經醫學職業嘅人 chiropractor
↳ 你有冇睇過脊醫？
　 Have you ever seen a chiropractor?

【專名】：香港地名；位於大嶼山西南一角（官方一般採用前面寫法）
Fan Lau, Lantau Island, Hong Kong

【動詞】：搭公共交通工具嗰時違規唔去畀應該要畀嘅車錢，或者唔依規定買飛入去要買飛嘅地方 to fare-dodge
↳ 逃票畀人捉到會罰好多錢。
　 If you fare-dodge and get caught, there will be a high fine.

【名詞】：牆上油後出現嘅細小凹痕 pin-holes on painted wall
↳ X

【名詞】：一種眼部疾病
trachoma
其他讀音：bei1 si2

【名詞】：〖外來語〗低音結他，音域低過結他，通常只有四條弦 bass guitar
↳ bass手
　 bassist; bass player

【名詞】：〖舊式〗〖香港〗香港五、六十年代嘅通俗小説
popular novels from 1950s to 1960s in Hong Kong; literally: 30-cent novel

【名詞】：〖舊式〗〖香港〗香港五、六十年代嘅通俗小説
popular novels from 1950s to 1960s in Hong Kong; literally: 30-cent novel

【名詞】：一種魚，金黃色，可以食用；頭骨入面有魚腦石（黃花魚石）（量詞：條） yellow croaker (fish)
↳ 黃花魚燉飯
　 Yellow croaker stewed with rice

【名詞】：一種魚，金黃色，可以食用；頭骨入面有魚腦石（黃花魚石）（量詞：條） yellow croaker (fish)
↳ 黃花魚燉飯
　 Yellow croaker stewed with rice

【語句】：歇後語；源自同名裁縫公司，下半句係「講一套做一套」 a pun meaning "to talk the talk but fails to walk the walk", literally "Kwun Kee Tailor"
↳ X

【形容詞】：〖外來語〗講嘢刻薄 mean; harsh; bitter; usually referring to words somebody says as opposed to actions
↳ mean精
　 A mean person
↳ 嘩！佢噉講嘢好mean啫！
　 Wow! That's really mean for him to say something like this!

【動詞】：〖外來語〗用説話取笑或者窒人哋 to tease; to make fun of someone in a verbal manner
↳ 我成日mean佢，串佢，我好enjoy。佢mean我，我會比佢更mean！
　 I often tease him, provoke him, and I enjoy it. If he teases me, I'll tease him back ten times over!

【副詞】：好有機發生 very likely
↳ 落咁大雨，黑雨都似。
　 It's raining so heavily, looks like black rainstorm signal.

【動詞】：背叛
to betray

【名詞】：〖舊式〗女性訂婚後未婚夫死咗
fiancee whose fiance died before marriage

【助詞】：嘅同吖嘛嘅合音；加喺句子後面，表示呢一個係對方理應知道嘅事，或者係必然會認同嘅判斷 a combination of 嘅 and 吖嘛; used at the end of a sentence to express that it is something that the listener/reader should be aware of, or something that they are expected to agree with
↳ 自然嘅嘢唔一定就係好𠺢嘛。
　 Being natural does not necessarily mean it is good, am I not right?
↳ 佢傻𠺢嘛，使乜理佢唧？
　 He's crazy, of course. Why bother with him?

females who are short in height; derogatory

↳ 懷柔政策
　 conciliation policy

【名詞】：〖外來語〗〖潮語〗「位置」英文location嘅音譯；一般指樓宇嘅位置（量詞：個） location (of buildings usually)
↳ 買樓第一係路畸唇，第二係路畸唇，第三都係路畸唇。

white bitter cucumber

chilli

【名詞】：蘿藦科夜來香屬嘅攀藤植物，又叫夜來香、夜蘭香、月見草
Chinese violet, Telosma cordata

【名詞】：呢種植物嘅花，可以食用 the flower of Telosma cordata, which can be consumed as a vegetable
↳ 滾湯落夜香花，清肝明目呀。
　 Add some Chinese violet flowers into the soup. It's medicinal for the liver and the eyes.

【區別詞】：小量嘅本錢 small capital

【名詞】：山邊嘅懸崖
mountain cliff

↳ 原本上年十一月搞嘅畢業禮，褪到而家先搞到。
　 The graduation ceremony that was supposed to be held in November last year got postponed until now.

【名詞】：基督宗教對公元嘅叫法

【名詞】：身體虛弱嘅人 physically weak person

　 Many people are just bystanders, laughing at other people.

【語句】：就字面解釋而唔理解實際意思 to interpret a text literally or in a simple-minded manner without understanding the underlying context
↳ X

【名詞】：夜晚見到銀河系嘅螺旋臂，由比較密集恒星組成 the spiral arm of the Milky Way seen at night
↳ 我見過銀河，望落去仲以為係一嚿雲。
　 I've seen the Milky Way. I thought it was a big cloud when I first saw it.

【名詞】：舊式時鐘，用鐘擺原理運作
grandfather clock

【名詞】：做睇相分析人哋嘅人

Rumours will stop at wise people

【名詞】：老年、中年同青年；泛指唔同年齡層嘅人

pronunciation: jat1 nap1 lai6 zi1 saam1 baa2 fo2
definition:
【語句】：響中醫角度荔枝性質燥熱，食一粒就好似食咗三把火咁，好易令人熱氣 according to traditional Chinese food therapy, the nature of lychee is 'dry and hot', eating one is like putting three burning torches into your body, can easily let one to have excessive interior heat; literally, one lychee is three burning torches
↳ 好食還好食，始終「一粒荔枝三把火」，燥熱嘅生果要適可而止呀。
　 Despite its great taste, remember "one lychee equals three burning torches." You should limit your intake of fruits of such "dry and hot" nature.

【名詞】：頭部嘅畫像或者雕像 head portrait; bust
↳ 圓明園生肖頭像
　 x
↳ 硬幣上面鑄有英女皇頭像。
　 x

【名詞】：引申指社交平台上嘅個人識認圖片（量詞：張／幅） profile picture
↳ 呢張你影我影得好靚，我攞咗張相做頭像。
　 You took such a good photo of me. I set it as my profile pic.
↳ 你覺唔覺得用動漫人物做頭像好毒？
　 x

↳ 短度闊封

↳ 呢匹布係48吋封，個度想剪幾長？
　 This roll of cloth is 48" in width, how long you would need to cut ?

【名詞】：用橡膠同乳膠造，有彈性嘅短圈，通常用嚟紮住啲嘢嘅（一般會講橡筋多啲）（量詞：條）
rubber band; elastic band (橡筋 is more commonly used)

【動詞】：不斷煩擾、纏擾住對方，好似隻冤鬼咁 to pester, to keep on disturb, stalking on someone, just like a grudged ghost
↳ 你成日冤住我都冇用𠿪，我冇錢借畀你呀。
　 It is no use pestering me all the time. I don't have money to lend you.

【語句】：不失為可行嘅做法；都可以接受 why not?

nickname for the Hong Kong Observatory

【動詞】：屈曲住 to curl up
↳ 痛到攣住個身
　 too hurt that have to curl up the body

【動詞】：磨蹭、依偎、纏綿 to nudge and rub lightly, to express love or passion on someone or something
↳ 我一返屋企隻狗就攣住我唔肯走。
　 When I back home my dog keeps nudging and rubbing me and refuses to leave.
↳ 呢張被質料真係好舒服，好鍾意攣住佢嚟瞓。
　 The material of this blanket is so tender, I like to nudge and rub it while sleeping.

【動詞】：出力同其他人比試 to strive against another or others
↳ 香港隊同韓國隊將會喺決賽中比拼，爭奪冠軍。
　 Hong Kong team will strive against South Korea team in the final to obtain the champion.

【名詞】：地球表面上大規模嘅空氣流動
atmospheric circulation

【名詞】：〖外來語〗大學（量詞：間） abbreviation of university
↳ 入U
　 to be admitted to university
↳ 讀U
　 to study in university

【名詞】：〖術語〗考試入面不予置評嘅級別 abbreviation of "unclassified", the lowest grade possible in public exams for students in Hong Kong
↳ 我會考有兩個U。
　 I obtained two unclassified in HKCEE.

【名詞】：〖術語〗電腦、電話入面用嚟做運算嘅組件（量詞：粒） CPU; central processor
↳ 有時靚嘅底板仲貴過粒U。
　 Sometimes a high quality motherboard is more expensive than a CPU.

【名詞】：街外客人（對於冇打算對外開放、招呼指定團體以外嘅人嘅商舖嚟講） outside guest; literally: street guest

【名詞】：街道風景 street view; streetscape
↳ 街景地圖
